grades.description: No microaneurysms, hemorrhages, or diabetic retinal lesions observed.
Microaneurysms only. No venous beading or hard exudates.
grades.clinical_action: Follow-up screening within 9 to 12 months with glycemic control counseling.

grades.description: More than microaneurysms but less than severe NPDR; dot/blot hemorrhages and hard exudates present.
Severe intraretinal hemorrhages in 4 quadrants, venous beading in 2+ quadrants, or prominent IRMA in 1+ quadrant.
grades.clinical_action: Urgent ophthalmologist referral within 2 to 4 weeks. High risk of progression.

grades.description: Neovascularization of the retina or disc (NVD/NVE), pre-retinal or vitreous hemorrhage.
grades.clinical_action: Immediate ophthalmologist referral within 24 to 48 hours for panretinal photocoagulation or anti-VEGF therapy.
